mainEntity.name: Can AI find leads and email prospects for me without creating spam problems?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AI can assist with prospect research, qualification notes, personalized draft outreach, and follow-up reminders, but it should not send mass or misleading messages automatically. Verify each prospect, explain the reason for contact, respect applicable communication requirements, and review personalization before sending.

## Context
Run My AI Business examples include researching potential sponsors, businesses that may need websites, and other prospects. The stated focus is researched prospects and appropriate outreach—not guaranteed leads or sales.

## Key factors
- Accuracy of prospect information
- Relevance of the offer
- Permission and communication preferences
- Human review of claims and personalization

## Practical guidance
Have the workflow produce a prospect record, evidence for the fit, a draft message, and a follow-up suggestion. Keep sending disabled until a person verifies the record and approves the message.

This preserves efficiency without turning research into uncontrolled outreach.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can research prospects, organize fit information, draft outreach, and suggest follow-ups, but a person should verify records and approve messages. Avoid unsupported claims, irrelevant mass contact, and automatic sending without appropriate review and communication controls.
